snapshotIdentity: Base commit plus exact current hashes; uncommitted audit sources are listed separately

history.boundary: Historical owner delivery only; not current branch/signature/matrix acceptance

optionalSurfaceSymbolScanBoundary: Symbol discovery only; the exact sourceRefs and explicit routes establish wiring, never runtime execution.

cameraPackageCopy.anchor: func copyPhotos(for id: UUID, documents: URL) throws -> [URL]

notificationPresentationContinuation.anchor: return try HanlinNotificationInvocation.enqueue(event, in: store, now: now)

share.stop: Owned share batches feed a Host chooser of installed NativeScript or Expo declared share actions, bound to installation/generation/entry/action. Resume dispatch uses the request broker; NativeScript invokes its registered action and Expo uses its foreground session action channel. An authored handler can call the canonical Host facade. Durable action receipts exist, but the original share ingress does not return a generic RuntimeExecutionResult automatically.

translation.stop: A declared NativeScript/Expo foreground action can carry selected text through an App Intent and the same Host action dispatch. Separately, native presentation programs render/edit/finish translation in the extension through original widget engines; that local presentation is not a canonical Host runtime passthrough. Neither route implies per-surface executed receipt coverage.

widget.stop: Original renderer callbacks retain their local execution path. An explicit hostAction validates the current widget program and one same-package Expo/NativeScript appIntent action, queues a foreground invocation and wakes the existing Host after enqueue. The real handler may call all five canonical runtimes and retains its actual action value/error. A placed-widget OS tap and runtime result readback require separate executed evidence.

notification.stop: A versioned tagged event is durably queued in its product App Group. Mutable remote alerts use the shared service; both early application delegates handle actual local/remote foreground delivery and responses, and foreground recovery reads actual OS-delivered notifications. The live Host rechecks installation/generation and a declared Expo/NativeScript appIntent action, then persists its real result/error. No React Native/NativeScript or canonical Host runtime executes in the notification extensions. Rich content separately renders its prepared original program locally and can enqueue the same validated event before forwarding the system action. OS delivery, locked storage, and surface-to-runtime cases still require actual attempt evidence.

liveActivity.stop: A ScriptWidget-rendered activity uses its declared widget hostAction with validated widget origin. A native-node ActivityKit activity uses its published appIntent action and a dedicated foreground LiveActivityIntent without fabricating widget origin. Both record the actual liveActivity source and wake the Host after enqueue; handlers may use all five canonical runtimes. Original Expo createLiveActivity callbacks remain their separate upstream path and do not implicitly consume hanlinWidget.hostAction metadata. Real OS surface execution remains a separate gate.

hostAppIntent.stop: Declared NativeScript and Expo actions dispatch through the installed-package broker and persist action value/status in a durable receipt. NativeScript admission preserves its one-VM ownership; Expo uses the visible foreground action channel. A handler may use its canonical Host facade, but the returned action value is not automatically the complete generic runtime receipt.

shortcuts.stop: Hanlin's typed installed-package action intent enqueues foreground continuation for NativeScript or Expo and wakes the existing Host after enqueue. ChavrusaChatShortcuts advertises alarm/notification phrases; the upstream ScriptWidget AppShortcutsProvider is not registered. Native snippets and original control intents are separate native UI/action surfaces.

spotlight.stop: Each product indexes declared enabled installed-package Spotlight entries, independently of widget instances, and reconciles metadata and removal on publication. OpenIntent resolves the current installation/generation. An entry without an exported action opens its real prepared app; only a validated declared action queues a foreground continuation whose handler may call the five canonical Host runtimes. Spotlight search/tap and runtime receipt return to Spotlight are not established by source indexing.

capture.stop: CameraCaptureIntent and its Control use the real locked-capture extension or foreground camera. AVFoundation writes JPEGs under sessionContentURL; openApplication hands off through the system. The app verifies and retains its own copy before system-session invalidation, copies photos into the selected package Documents area, then invokes the required declared action with installation/generation checks and a stable queue identity. The locked process has no App Group, network or package runtime. Canonical Host runtime calls happen only after foreground handoff; physical capture and complete receipt return to the ingress remain separate acceptance.

foreground.stop: NativeScript generic async and Expo facades reach the shared canonical JSON/full RuntimeExecutionResult route. NativeScript captures its bound bridge and session-owned cancellation; legacy strings retain their historical boundary. This generator records source wiring and imports no native or physical acceptance verdict.

scriptWidgetControls.sourceSupport: Original button/toggle ControlWidget wrappers, configuration intents, entity/value providers and actions are registered in both widget bundles. Original widget.json actions/controls are projected into current installation/generation state and the widget action executor. Original source provenance and automatic refresh are retained.

widgets.sourceSupport: Original engine widget rendering and actions exist, including the original Expo Widgets module, registration picker, timeline and configuration integration. This is separate from a canonical Host-runtime bridge.

nativePresentations.sourceSupport: Declared native snippet/translation programs execute through original widget engines with invocation-owned state and actual native controls. Translation expansion/text replacement uses the native provider context; it is not a React Native or NativeScript VM inside the extension.

liveActivities.sourceSupport: Original Expo ActivityKit and original ScriptWidget component/region rendering have native lifecycle integration. Local controls refresh declared activity state with current installation/generation checks.

keyboard.sourceSupport: A real UIInputViewController chooses a published installed-package keyboard presentation. The original prepared renderer receives document context; validated effects call textDocumentProxy insertion/deletion/cursor movement or the system next-keyboard API. Renderer/service mutable storage stays extension-local. This keyboard is not a React Native/NativeScript app VM or a canonical Host-runtime ingress.

richNotification.sourceSupport: A real UNNotificationContentExtension validates the published presentation identity/category and renders its original prepared program with extension-local mutable state. Matching installation/package/generation ties optional continuation to the existing notification event; the exact event is persisted before the system default action/response forwards to the foreground Host. A queued receipt is not execution completion. Ordinary notifications retain system content without a fabricated MiniApp.

matrixScope: Ten ingress categories by two native app engines by five canonical Host runtimes (100 conditional source routes); original library rendering and keyboard/rich-notification presentation records are separate. Plain Spotlight app-open does not itself execute a runtime.
sourceReadPolicy: Current local bytes take precedence; only missing tracked files use exact HEAD blobs, including the Swift symbol scan.

publicBindingStatus.hanlinNativeScript: No generic HanlinSystemServicesBroker facade in the inspected Host adapter. Original native SDK APIs and ScriptWidget service providers are separate API paths; this does not classify them as absent.
publicBindingStatus.hanlinExpo: No generic HanlinSystemServicesBroker facade in the inspected Host adapter. Original native SDK APIs and ScriptWidget service providers are separate API paths; this does not classify them as absent.
